what: No harness case runs forked_target=true with a real upstream git fixture, diff >2 non-runtime files, and asserts generate-code-flow-diagram.sh is invoked with --base-remote upstream
scenario_or_breakage: Proposed diagram-skip-forked only asserts the generator is absent from calls.log; augmented green only checks --base-remote origin when --forked-target false. Existing forked-target (lines 464-470) asserts upstream argv on rebase-checkpoint-probe.sh only. A regression that still passes upstream to rebase but omits --base-remote/--base-ref on the step-7a.sh:346 generator call (or passes origin) would not fail CI
suggested_fix: Add make_forked_generate_repo() (upstream remote, no origin; >2 docs-only paths vs upstream/main) plus new_case diagram-generate-forked (or extend forked-target to cd into that repo) mirroring green success assertions and assert_file_contains on calls.log for generate-code-flow-diagram.sh … --base-remote upstream --base-ref main; keep diagram-skip-forked for the skip path
